acceptance: Pausing A never cancels or blocks B, and session APIs remain responsive while cancellation unwinds.
Pause persistence precedes cancellation; repeated pause is idempotent and invalid targets cannot affect other runs.
No pause action in reply metadata; composer control captures session/run/workspace and ignores stale responses after navigation.
Scoped tests, native Safari component observation, docs, incremental push and local8097 backup/update/smoke.

requirements.summary: User reports all chats collapse after pausing from reply header. Runtime has no observed restart/panic; reproduce and distinguish backend lock coupling from UI failure.

design.summary: Persist under mutex, cancel outside it; scope UI request/ack to captured session/run/workspace, remove reply pause and reuse composer control.

implementation.summary: Pause persists under lock and cancels after unlock; repeat requests idempotent. Removed reply pause, reused composer pause with captured session/workspace and pending state.

verification.summary: Both Go race regressions and quick passed. Mock HTTP A pauses while B completes; deliberately slow cancellation does not block B API. Native Safari offline production-controls fixture observed dark/light, narrow, disabled pending and stale acknowledgement after switching. Actual runtime browser behind certificate warning.

documentation.summary: Recording behavior, evidence boundaries and AIDE-only rollout.

cleanup.summary: Existing vendor deletions and unrelated local checkout changes preserved; no test requests to real model.

release_authorization: Prior user authorized incremental tests/push/docs and local8097 AIDE-only update; no main merge or Release.
rollback: Retain prior local image and consistent data backup before AIDE-only replacement; preserve unrelated work and all mounts.
handoff: No observed runtime restart/panic; exact user-reported full collapse not reproduced. Verified shared-lock cancellation hazard and session-scoped UI fixes. Local compatibility checkout lacked composer pause markup/style; added only those pieces without copying whole frontend.
